name: St. John's
type: big city; city in Newfoundland and Labrador
text: St. John's is the capital and largest city of the Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador. It is located on the eastern tip of the Avalon Peninsula on the island of Newfoundland.

depictions.name: St. John's
depictions.text: St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador St. John's is the capital of Newfoundland and Labrador, the easternmost province of Canada.
